flight_domain.empirical_rule: matching explicit observable envelope required; otherwise abstain

trajectory_input.altitude_assumption: reported altitude treated as geometric height; actual reference unknown
trajectory_input.clock_assumption: synthetic clock; source timezone does not align a real IMU
trajectory_input.interpolation: PCHIP within short observed intervals only; no provider estimates or long-gap bridging

config.evidence_use: matched development timing/storage and assumption diagnostic only; no threshold or tail evidence

execution_policy.evidence_use: partition unchanged; preparation grants no execution budget
